title: The bathroom shooting at the headquarters company
description: A drunk soldier from another company or unit shot a man in the chest in the shower at the headquarters company, right next to Larry's hooch. Larry, who did not know the man in the shower, saw where the bullet hit and turned to help him — and the gunman pointed the gun at Larry and aimed it at him. Sgt. Weaver, an E5, showed up; the gunman, drunk, with his eyes rolled back, passed out. Air Force police took Larry's statement. Larry heard afterwards that the shooter knew the man he shot, and that he was imprisoned in Okinawa at hard labor for twenty years. His bunk mate Ron Tototz was with him. Larry expects the shooter was court-martialed: "there should be a record."
